tables.name: Location Notability
tables.description: Why a notable additional location is notable.

results.name: Generous Spirit
results.description: The location owner is known in the community for their generosity (this could be financial, but could also be with their time, knowledge, or resources).

results.name: Top-Notch Marketing
results.description: All around the city you can see signage, or hear people mentioning, the location.

results.name: Excellent Offerings
results.description: Whatever product or service the location offers, it’s good enough to draw notice.

results.name: Vested Interests
results.description: A third party (not the shopkeeper or an employee) has a stake in whether this location is successful, and has done something to ensure the populus know about it.

results.name: Unique Offering
results.description: This location has a product or service that no one else in the city has.

results.name: More-Than-Meets-the-Eye
results.description: This location may seem to be one thing, but the right people know what else is there.

results.name: Meeting Place
results.description: The establishment is in a particular location which is a prime landmark for people to easily meet. This tends to generate business by proximity.

results.name: Entertaining Service
results.description: Something about the folk that work here is very entertaining. Perhaps they’re funny, or maybe they do demonstrations, or even have a bard who plays there regularly.

results.name: Coercion
results.description: Customers, who might otherwise go somewhere else, are pressured into coming here instead. This could be the owner’s doing, but could also be the work of another interested party.

results.name: Favoritism
results.description: Certain people are given particularly good service here, and it incentivizes them to frequent this location.

results.name: Superstition
results.description: Those who frequent this location do so out of the belief that if they don’t, something will (or won’t) happen.

results.name: History
results.description: This location is notable for its links to local history. Perhaps it belongs to a family with a particular reputation? Maybe it has ties to events from long ago?

results.name: Rumors
results.description: Something intriguing has been heard about this place that, for some reason, has piqued visitor’s curiosity.

results.name: Expansion
results.description: This place has grown recently.

results.name: Important Person
results.description: Someone directly involved with this location (owner, employee, etc) is a major figure in the community.

results.name: Nearby Curiosity
results.description: There is something in very close proximity that draws attention, thereby increasing foot traffic.

results.name: Local Loyalty
results.description: People who live nearby know this place and stick to it out of a deep-seated loyalty, even if there would seem to be better alternatives.

results.name: Exciting
results.description: There always seems to be something thrilling going on here, so those seeking to be free of boredom show up in droves.

results.name: Organization Affiliation
results.description: Association with certain people has generated traffic to this location.

results.name: Magic
results.description: Some form of magic plays a role in what is drawing people here. It could be on purpose or accidental, innocent or malicious.
